item_0.heading: Tier-1 Global Bank — Financial Services
item_0.name: Features Item
item_0.text:

item_1.heading: Pan-India Retailer — E-Commerce & Retail
item_1.name: Features Item
item_1.text:
India's third-largest omnichannel retailer replaced their fragmented CMS and e-commerce stack with DXP AI — enabling AI-driven personalization across 2,000+ store locations and their digital platform.

  • 4.2× faster content production cycle
  • 32% increase in average order value via ZensAI recommendations
  • 76% reduction in technology stack cost

item_2.heading: Regional Health System — Healthcare
item_2.name: Features Item
item_2.text:
A network of 45 hospitals and clinics deployed DXP AI as their unified patient and employee portal platform — replacing 6 separate legacy portals and dramatically improving patient digital self-service.

  • 92% patient portal adoption within 6 months of launch
  • 60% reduction in patient call center volume
  • HIPAA-compliant with full audit trail
  • Full deployment completed in 6 months

item_3.heading: Global Manufacturer — Industrial & B2B
item_3.name: Features Item
item_3.text:
A Fortune 500 industrial manufacturer deployed DXP AI to replace 7 regional dealer and distributor portals with one global platform — integrating SAP, Salesforce, and ServiceNow in a single unified experience.

  • 7 regional portals replaced by 1 global platform
  • 3× increase in distributor self-service rate
  • Dealer onboarding time reduced from 2 weeks to 2 days
  • SAP + Salesforce + ServiceNow integration in 8 weeks
